news.h: Patriots' A.J. Brown has career-high 3 dropped passes in return from injury
news.d: Patriots receiver A.J. Brown, coming off a right high ankle sprain that sidelined him four weeks, had a shaky return to action Sunday, dropping a career-high three passes in the team's win over the Jets

news.h: Patriots activate WR A.J. Brown for Sunday's game vs. Jets
news.d: Patriots wide receiver A.J. Brown was activated from injured reserve Saturday after missing the past four games with a right high ankle sprain, the team announced.

news.h: Drake Maye's 3 TD passes help Patriots stave off late push by Jets in 26-19 win

news.h: Patriots' Romeo Doubs hurt on 42-yard TD catch vs. Jets

news.h: Things you don't know about Patriots running back Rhamondre Stevenson
